title: Deep nether
description: here's everything like nether,but so cold.
body:
This mod allows you to travel to a place even deeper than the Nether.

Everything there is very similar to the Nether, but unlike it, the environment is very cold and cruel.

If you go there without proper preparation, you will be trapped forever!

**This mod is currently in early development and may contain many bugs so using a backup is recommended.**




**how to enter the deep nether?**

you need find a ruined portal and use key to active.

ruined portal only spawn in nether.
![Ruined Deeper Nether Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/79648da0cd317cc808b5638c9ce4015b5eae2c43.png)
![key](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1756195fb2812173c71273267561341c5676096.png)

when you enter the deeper nether,portal will be immediate destroy,cannot use.
![broken portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2936db45839abba8769e70527872669af2e01ff.png)

**Now,only one way to get back to the surface,you need find portal altar.**
![the altar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4dcad34a3f788344c1a8d60a0757babd7c5b419d.png)

just rightclick altar can back the surface spawn point.
